content: Better an open and declared adversary than a treacherous and smiling friend.
author: Celtic & Norse Proverbs
sourceWork: Hávamál (Stanza 42 & 43) — The Sayings of the High One
explanation: An open enemy stands with sword drawn; you know where they stand and you can prepare your shield. But a false friend smiles at your table while whispering poison behind your back. Value honest opposition infinitely higher than counterfeit loyalty.
practicalInsight: Be an honest, direct communicator today. Never smile and flatter someone to their face while harboring resentment.
reflectionPrompt: Where are you performing false friendliness when what the relationship genuinely needs is honest, direct truth?
